$schema: Charta Ratificationis — Individual Term Card Schema

canonical_name.description: The ratified canonical name. This is the name. Everything else annotates it.

english_name.description: English translation or plain-register equivalent. May be null if the canonical name is already English.

stratum.description: The Nomenclatura Arcana stratum. See Stratum I CLASSICA, Stratum II ARCANA, Stratum III ABSURDUM.

category.description: Functional category — what type of thing this term names.

definition.description: The canonical definition. Written in the voice of the Cogniverse. Dense, authoritative, final.

epithets.description: Ratified epithets. Flavour designations with canonical standing. Not competing names.

aliases.description: Acceptable informal or shorthand forms. In active use but not the canonical name.

related_terms.description: Terms with direct semantic or structural relationship to this term.

banned_forms.description: Forms explicitly prohibited — spelling errors, deprecated names, or cosmologically banned vocabulary.

notes.description: Supplementary information — lore weight, usage guidance, implementation notes, canonical exceptions.

ratified_by.description: The Wizard who ratified. Always LordFingers.

sediment.description: True if the term is retired to the geological record — not struck, not active. Preserved.

deferred.description: True if the term is ratified in name but implementation or full definition is pending.

status_definitions.ratified: Canonical. In active use. The Tower remembers it.
status_definitions.sediment: Retired from active canonical use. Preserved in the geological record. Nothing is ever truly gone — only classified by its relationship to the present.
status_definitions.deferred: Name ratified. Full definition or implementation pending a dedicated session.
status_definitions.struck: Does not exist. Was never real. The record shows only that it was considered and found wanting.

stratum_definitions.I — CLASSICA: Real Latin or Greek. Correctly or plausibly inflected. Carries genuine etymological weight.
stratum_definitions.II — ARCANA: Invented Latinate constructions. Real roots, real suffixes, fabricated words. Plausibly Latin — as if a Roman archivist needed to name something that did not exist yet.
stratum_definitions.III — ABSURDUM: Deliberate tonal rupture. French is canonical. Creature-words. Phonological comedy. Never accidental. The Absurd is devoted.

signum_verifix.description: The SIGNUM VERIFIX appears on every ratified card. It is the mark that makes a term real.
